outcome_exposure: NOT_EXPOSED — this artifact DEFINES the outcome; it does not read it

CLOCK.authority: VERIFIED FROM DATA, not from column naming
evidence: consecutive bar_start delta = 15 min, single value

CORRECTION_APPLIED.defect: an earlier proposal placed claim-known at 09:45 / 10:00 / 10:15
CORRECTION_APPLIED.nature: those are LEFT-hand bar closes; the pair's second token does not yet exist
CORRECTION_APPLIED.severity: a 15-minute LOOKAHEAD — first-class defect, caught before any prespec was sealed

CLAIM_KNOWN_TIME.rule: close timestamp of the RIGHT-HAND bar

ENTRY.price_authority: next-bar OPEN, NOT the right-hand bar's closing print
ENTRY.why_not_NEXT_SESSION_OPEN: the daily-signal precedents use next-session open because their signal completes at/after a close. Importing it here would carry a daily-signal assumption into an intraday family without a timing argument.
ENTRY.overlap_check: M1->M2 enters at idx 2, which is M3's bar. NOT lookahead: the claim reads only idx 0 and idx 1 and consumes only the OPEN of idx 2, known exactly at 10:00 ET.

HORIZON.rule: licensed entry -> that session's OWN final regular-session bar close
HORIZON.rejected_formulation: 'entry -> 16:00 ET' — literally wrong on early-close sessions

EARLY_CLOSE_IS_NOT_MISSINGNESS.reason: if every bar to that session's real close is present, the FULL regular session was observed. Treating it as censored would convert a structural CALENDAR FACT into missingness.
EARLY_CLOSE_IS_NOT_MISSINGNESS.outcome_status: VALID whenever the complete path from entry to that session's own close exists

SESSION_LENGTH.primary_analysis: RETAINED — not excluded; shorter exposure is controlled by stratification in the null

PRIMARY_Y.name: MAX_ABS_EXCURSION, prior-ATR normalised
PRIMARY_Y.normaliser: prior-state ATR — the scale must come from state BEFORE the claim's right-hand bar (lookahead guard, not a performance choice)
PRIMARY_Y.naming_note: deliberately NOT called MAE — in trading jargon MAE means ADVERSE excursion
PRIMARY_Y.direction_neutrality: the tokens are STATES and carry no direction; assigning LONG/SHORT post hoc is forbidden
PRIMARY_Y.question_it_answers: is this ordered state pair followed by unusually large subsequent movement, with no direction assigned in advance?

SECONDARY_DESCRIPTIVE.role: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY — none is a promotion path
SECONDARY_DESCRIPTIVE.explicit: the direction of the realised maximum must NOT become a second selection channel

PRIMARY_STATISTIC.theta: median(Y | claim positive) - median(Y | evaluable non-positive)
PRIMARY_STATISTIC.why_median: excursion outcomes are heavy-tailed; a mean would be dominated by a few extreme movers
PRIMARY_STATISTIC.identical_for_all: the same statistic applies to all 20,751 claims

ALTERNATIVE.H1: pair-positive episodes have GREATER direction-neutral excursion than evaluable non-fire episodes

NULL.Y_treatment: Y is permuted within security x position_pair x session_length_class

SHARED_MAP.rule: the SAME permutation map is used for ALL 20,751 claims within a draw
SHARED_MAP.REJECTED_ALTERNATIVE: independently permuting each claim's positive/non-positive labels
SHARED_MAP.why_rejected: that would destroy the real cross-claim dependence and make the family-wide max-stat null TOO NARROW — an anti-conservative correction

NULL.per_draw: compute the statistic for all 20,751 claims, record the MAXIMUM

MULTIPLICITY.DSR_and_clustered_CI: permitted as ADDITIONAL robustness layers; NOT promotion authority
MULTIPLICITY.no_cherry_picking: promotion must not select among several mutually independent corrections

why_no_theta_min.surface_reason: any specific number (e.g. 0.25 ATR) would be arbitrary today
why_no_theta_min.deeper_reason: the primary Y is DIRECTION-NEUTRAL excursion. A rationale such as 'theta_min > transaction costs' would be a CATEGORY ERROR: transaction costs presuppose a directional trading rule, and this family has neither a direction nor an execution strategy.
why_no_theta_min.meaning: effect size is fully reported; what is refused is inventing a practical-significance boundary for an outcome that has no trading interpretation yet

CLAIM_SCOPE.if_a_directional_hypothesis_later_arises: it is a NEW registered hypothesis, and an economically meaningful threshold may be frozen BEFORE its Y is seen

HISTORICAL_HOLDOUT_2026_08_07_to_08_24.note: a successful holdout does NOT equal a promotion-confirmed discovery

AUTHORITY_LAYERS.source_HOLD_or_unavailable_interval: permanently NON-EVIDENTIARY; never backfilled into confirmation

INHERITED_FROM_PRECEDENT.basis: same measurement problem / timing logic / inferential objective / availability requirements — NEVER historical success
items: MAE and terminal return descriptive only
first look on an OUTCOME-INDEPENDENT trigger
horizon/entry/normaliser immutable after any outcome is seen
